solutionSql:
SELECT s.customer_id,
       SUM(i.amount) AS billed_amount
FROM invoices i
JOIN shipments s ON s.id = i.shipment_id
GROUP BY s.customer_id
ORDER BY s.customer_id;

rules.howSolved: Drove the query from invoices and joined each invoice to its one shipment, so no invoice is summed twice.
Used an inner join from invoices and grouped by customer, so customers with no invoices do not appear.

notes: Customer comes from shipments.customer_id via the invoice shipment. Row counts per dataset: sample=6, nulls=3, boundary=6, precision=6. Ran on every listed dataset without error.
